return(function()
local _ls=loadstring or load
if not _ls or not string or not table then return end
if (1==2) then return end
local function _emXTQUnMjr(x,y)
 if bit32 then return bit32.bxor(x,y) end
 local r,p=0,1
 while x>0 or y>0 do local m,n=x%2,y%2 if m~=n then r=r+p end x,y,p=(x-m)/2,(y-n)/2,p*2 end
 return r
end
local function _u9hXjqBE_V(e,key)
 local r={}
 for _dmp1LC=1,#e do
  local bi=e[_dmp1LC]
  local ki=key:byte(1+(_dmp1LC-1)%#key)
  local salt=((_dmp1LC-1)*131+17)%256
  local i0=_dmp1LC-1
  local salt2=_emXTQUnMjr((i0*29)%256,math.floor(i0/8)%256)
  r[_dmp1LC]=string.char(_emXTQUnMjr(_emXTQUnMjr(_emXTQUnMjr(bi,ki),salt),salt2))
 end
 return table.concat(r)
end
